services.desc: We hope you’re considering Communication because you are already familiar with our mission and our house rules, but here are some pertinent details about the space: Communication is an all-ages and sober space. If your private event is not all-ages friendly, please share more details as we may still be able to accommodate your request for a closed event. Face masks are required inside our space at all times. We request that you bring your own (high quality, such as an N95 or KN95) masks if possible.
